\n- owns: `<sub>/<manifest:domain.books.from>`, `<sub>/<manifest:domain.books.from>/<slot>`, `domain/<sub>/<manifest:domain.kept>`, `domain/<sub>/<manifest:domain.kept>/*`, `domain/<sub>/worker`, `domain/<sub>/heartbeat`;

\n- writes: `domain/book-want/<sub>/<manifest:domain.books>/<part>` (create), `domain/member-want/<part>` (create), `domain/<sub>/<manifest:domain.books>/<member>` (cas), `<sub>/<manifest:domain.witness.report>/<name>` (put);

\n- reads: `domain/<sub>/<manifest:domain.books>/*`, `domain/<sub>/<manifest:domain.books>/*/<part>`, `domain/view-rows/<part>`, `domain/relay-for`, `<sub>/slots/<name>`, `platform/manifest/<sub>/rev` (the mark: a manifest change — P/02.3 N3), `domain/keys`, `domain/revoked`, `/etc/w2c/tls/<role>/server.key` (its own set of the role of the domain worker — the door door.pass under TLS, N1.6 door_client), `domain/view` (the count by the domain view).
\nOne's own slot is read before the first write of a contribution.
\n**`source_row`.** an element of the row is an input of the book:\nthe name of the element is item (non-empty), the value is the text of a JSON object
\n**`writer`.** rights — the platform\nbase of the role (P/02.5 N1.4: «domain book sources»).
\n**`writer`.** worker.writes is not needed

\n**`claim`.** During the cleanup of P/03.7-R041 the worker neither reads nor changes contributions of another subsystem, even with the same slot name: released := taking → delete the rows\nby the guard of the slot → released := false (chapter 3.2 N3), then the subsystem writes the contributions anew, as at start.

\n**`claim`.** After a cleanup capture, reset the subsystem's written-contribution memory as specified in P/03.7-R043; without that reset, a server cut off, not dead, after withdrawal and revocation would regain the name by a repeated capture without contributions while alive.
\nThe slot and\n`released` — chapter 3.2 N1.4.
\nCapture, IO and cryptography still follow the ordinary procedures below.
\nThe holder's signing key is not handed to the worker, nor is the member's key: the token is requested by the worker that needs it, through the agent of its own\ncluster.
\nThe owner of the token file for `keep: true` is the kind, not the camera.
\nThe limit of retaining a token with `keep: true`: theft of the box gives that token until revocation.
\nA token in whose audience\nthere is no recipient cluster is `wrong_audience`.
\nA token of a kind other than the recipient expects is `wrong_kind`.
\nThe meaning of the recipient's own claims (`ref_claim`, `acts`) is the subsystem's.
\n**`domain_worker`.** one: the slot `domain/<sub>/worker` (lease — chapter 3.2 N1.4).
\n**`domain_worker`.** it exists for a manifest that has kept or a carried book.
\n**`domain_worker`.** the unit `<dep>-<sub>domain.service` — on every server with w2c-domain, one is active by the slot (P/02.4 N1.12).
\n**`domain_worker`.** The capture after LOST_AFTER + HOLD_SKEW (P/03.7-R072) applies only to the domain-worker slot; it does not apply to slots of cluster members.
\n**`kept`.** The kept rows are not delivered to a member.
\n**`kept`.** domain.tables — which of kept are tables (P/06.1 N1.6)

**`heartbeat`.** worker —
is exactly the string «`domain/<sub>/worker`», the full key of its slot (the grammar of the slot name of chapter 3.2 does not
apply to it).
\n**`heartbeat`.** a heartbeat with another worker is out of form\n(checked by reading — the stand does not carry a domain worker).
\n**`heartbeat`.** written by `<sub>domain` every HEARTBEAT_EVERY and\nby the stand-in (chapter 3.4 N3).
\nThe heartbeat — [chapter 3.4](03.4-worker.norms.md) N1.1 and N3\n«stand_in()».

\nThe races of a contribution — [P/08.5 N3](../../08-domain/spec/08.5-domain.norms.md)\n«Races» (a late write of a former holder is fenced off by the guard, a surviving row — by the cleanup at capture and by the liveness filter of the agent).
\nNo memory of the issued ones is needed, except for a kind with `keep: true`: the row `domain/issued` (P/08.2 N1.6a).
